pricingModel: R3 is operated on the Monta platform; public Monta CPO pricing exposes exact EVSE tariffs. Historic/headline R3 rates are not universal fallbacks.
rule: Join only on the exact R3 EVSE ID from the official/open-data inventory to the corresponding Monta CPO-pricing row and use the tariff components returned for that EVSE. Never apply the 0.55 EUR/kWh historic rapid-charge headline to unmatched EVSE or to AC/other classes. Unmatched rows remain fail-closed.
